changes.summary: Refreshed the pinned core runtime to ComfyUI 0.34.0.
changes.details: The source bundle now hash-locks stable tag v0.34.0 at exact commit 12d52794 and its verified source archive. Model artifacts, core-node workflow parameters, admission envelopes, and Candidate qualification are unchanged.

changes.summary: Marked the 14B I2V profile memory-tight and physical-OOM-gated.
changes.details: The catalog now exposes the declared 126 GB startup-plus-reserve envelope and makes clear this Candidate is not the default before a physical OOM canary passes.

changes.summary: Added signed typed prompt, image, and MP4 result slots.
changes.details: The adapter now consumes the prompt and reference image from their signed manifest slots, while the recipe declares exact input limits and one bounded MP4 result.

changes.summary: Required a prompt and fail-closed Wan MP4 result validation.
changes.details: The adapter rejects blank prompts before model linking and requires one H.264 640x640, 81-frame, 16 fps MP4 with a matching duration.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Initial candidate two-expert core-node ComfyUI image-to-video release for Wan 2.2 I2V 14B on a single Spark.
